raw_segments.text: The comfort and happiness she enjoyed were making her stronger, and she had them always
If she came home from her errands wet and tired and hungry, she knew she would soon
be warm and well-fed after she had climbed the stairs.
During the hardest day, she could occupy herself blissfully by thinking of what she should
see when she opened the attic door and wondering what new delight had been prepared for her.
In a very short time, she began to look less thin.
Color came into her cheeks, and her eyes did not seem so much too big for her face.
